versions.changelog: Fixed misleading ANTHROPIC_API_KEY comment; clarified PHI forwarding to Anthropic when backend is used; added CORS production warning
Fixed env var declarations; added ANTHROPIC_API_KEY disclosure; added PHI/privacy warning
Fixed inaccurate formulary claim; added explicit PHI/privacy warning
Added GitHub repository link, homepage, and MIT LICENSE file

Initial release of Clinical Documentation Assistant.

- Drafts common clinical documents (SOAP notes, referral letters, prior authorizations, discharge summaries, and care plan narratives) for clinicians, practice managers, or healthcare developers.
- Connects to any FHIR R4-compliant EHR (Epic, Cerner, Azure Health Data Services, HAPI FHIR) to pull structured patient data.
- Supports both fully automated (via API) and manual-document workflows when no EHR connection is available.
- Document draft output only: all drafts must be reviewed, edited, and signed by licensed clinicians.
- Includes sandbox mode for easy testing without EHR credentials.
- Offers detailed instructions for setup, patient lookup, and document generation.
